answer: Sybil resistance is enforced through a resource-proportional staking model requiring agents to commit computational capital before they can publish state updates, effectively creating a high ridge for entry. An attacker seeking to harbor a virtual army of fake identities would face massive compute costs, as each identity must independently stake real value. The economic lagoon operates on this scarcity, ensuring that aggregating these fake nodes is prohibitively expensive and the cost of manipulation always exceeds potential gains.
